blocks.name: tool-call
blocks.title: Tool call
blocks.description: One call an agent made to a tool: its name, whether it is running, done or failed, and on demand what went in and what came back.

blocks.name: approval
blocks.title: Approval
blocks.description: A request to do something the agent may not do on its own: what will happen, the exact command, and buttons to allow or deny it. The answer stays on screen.

blocks.name: stream
blocks.title: Stream
blocks.description: An answer that is still being written: the text so far with a caret, a line that says the agent is working, and a button to stop it.

blocks.name: citations
blocks.title: Citations
blocks.description: A numbered marker for running text and the list of sources it points at, each with its title, where it is from and the passage that was used.
